freeze.prompt:
Rewrite this text as one complete English sentence in different words. Preserve its meaning, names and facts. Use 12 to 35 words. Return the replacement alone, with no heading or explanation.

{}

protocol.change_intersection: Keep a primary range only where it intersects a changed token in the exact paired draft.
protocol.draft_comparison: Exact changed tokens as factual version evidence. It does not attribute the edit to AI.
protocol.paired_direction: Same-count drafts with a changed native context and overlapping exact changed token. Both independent detector odds must at least double.
protocol.primary: First six native three-sentence primary responses at or above the incumbent point.
protocol.useful: At least one proposal has 0.30 IoU and covers half the replaced sentence, ignoring whitespace.
